# `relation_kind`

A kind of relation a mind holds toward a persona or a group: its range, default, fade, and the flags `opposes`, `sides_with`, `avoids`, `orders` and `intervenes` the engine reads (15 §9.1).

## Fields

Besides these, a definition takes the [keys every definition carries](README.md#keys-every-definition-carries).

- `name` ([text](../values.md#texts), or `null`; optional): What a reader calls it.
- `kind` (one of `"value"`, `"flag"` ([`RelationShape`](#relationshape)); optional): `value` (the default), a number within `range`; or `flag`, 1 while held.
- `range` (list of 2: number, number; optional): The least and the most it can be. Default `[-1, 1]`; a flag's is `[0, 1]` whatever is written.
- `default` (number; optional): What it is when nobody has set it, and what it fades toward. Default 0.
- `fade` (number; optional): How far it moves toward `default` each minute of the holder's own time. Default 0: it does not fade.
- `opposes` (`true` or `false`; optional): Held above its default, it makes the one it is held toward an enemy (09 §3.4).
- `sides_with` (`true` or `false`; optional): Held above its default, it makes the one it is held toward a friend (09 §3.4).
- `orders` (`true` or `false`; optional): Held above its default by the one an order is given to, toward the one it takes for the giver, it makes the order one to obey (15 §10).
- `intervenes` (`true` or `false`; optional): Held above its default toward someone, it makes the holder a candidate for windows opened against them (15 §9.1; 03 §7.1).
- `avoids` (`true` or `false`; optional): Held above its default toward someone, it makes them one to keep away from: the AI's `feared` stance (09 §6.6).
- `doc` (string; optional): What it is, for the reference.

<a id="relationshape"></a>
### `RelationShape`

Whether a relation kind holds a number or is only there or not.

One of:

- `"value"`: A number within the kind's `range`.
- `"flag"`: 1 while held, 0 otherwise: `commands`, `guards`.
